title: Onboard aegir-7b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Marina Patel
description: This PR adds the Aegir-7b v1.0 model to the model registry with its metadata, performance profiles (GPU/CPU/quantized), and automated changelog entry generation. Motivation: provide a validated performance profile for a community-contributed 7B model and enable automated release notes so downstream consumers see supported configs in Console and the SDKs. Changes include: 1) model metadata (weights location, topology, tokenizer, download checksum, recommended sequence lengths, kv-cache hints), 2) perf profiles for baseline and quantized INT8 on T4/A10, including batch/latency curves and recommended batcher settings, 3) CI onboarding smoke checks to verify load+generate on a small sample prompt, and 4) automation to populate changelogs/changelog index when new models are merged. Checklist: - [x] metadata schema validated (yamllint + schema check) - [x] perf profile generation scripts ran and uploaded to perf store - [x] CI smoke tests added and passing - [x] docs update with model entry and quickstart example - [x] changelog entry template wired to automation hook Notes: perf values are collected from the perf-lab runs on T4 and A10 instances using the standard benchmark harness (50 prompts, 512 context, 32 warmup). Quantized profiles were generated using the quantizer pipeline with azimuth: int8 static quantization and verified for functional parity on a held-out sample. This PR intentionally keeps the model entry read-only for hosted until legal completes the license check (Linear ENG-2142). See linked Linear tasks for the follow-ups (release gating and canary rollout plan).
